title: BromhexIne And Spironolactone For CoronаVirUs Infection Requiring HospiTalization
brief_summary: Patients with mild and severe COVID 19 will be randomized 1:1 into two groups: experimental, which will get bromhexine and spironolactone, and control. Patients will get investigated therapy for ten days. Change in clinical assessment score COVID 19 (CAS COVID 19) between baseline and 12th day will be evaluated as a primary endpoint. Forty-five-day risk of death or mechanical ventilation will also be assessed.

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy and breastfeeding
* hypersensitivity to Spironolactone
* hypersensitivity to Bromhexine
* Known liver failure
* Glomerular filtration rate \<20 ml/ min
* physician judgment that the patient will need mechanical ventilation in 24 hours
* other indications for Spironolactone
* Active cancer
